source_facts.statement: cnot syntax is `cnot.type d, a;` with `.type = { .b16, .b32, .b64 }`.
CNOT is described as logical negation and sets `d = (a==0) ? 1 : 0;`.
Operands must match in size, but not necessarily in type.
All PTX instructions have an optional guard predicate.
False guarded execution does nothing: `Threads with a False guard predicate do nothing.`

derived_interpretations.statement: Bounded form is `cnot.b32`, so instruction is 32-bit in this unit.
Execution condition is no guard -> true, @p -> p, @!p -> not p.
State-writing behavior for bounded model is destination-only assignment on execute and unchanged state on false guard.
No error/UB/implementation-defined behavior is evidenced in retrieved cnot text; absence is treated as open until independently confirmed.

design_dependencies.statement: Single-step execution relation with execute / guard-false branches and no explicit error constructor.
Bounded scope stays at scalar `.b32` only; register destination and source shapes are the default chosen representation.
